description:
Estimate landed cost. Estimate a shipment total from hts_code or product, total fob_usd and quantity; returns duty lines, fees and total/per-unit cents with tax-date notes. Pass hts_code for a calculation; with only product you get a lookup link, not a number. Show top_3 to the user first. free, rate-limited.
到岸成本估算。按 hts_code 或 product、整票 fob_usd 和 quantity 估算到岸成本；返回税费明细、整票及单件美分金额和税率日期说明。要算钱请传 hts_code；只给 product 只回查询链接，不给数字。 先把 top_3 给用户看。免费，限次。
name: estimate_landed_cost
